items.a: Nahi. Hum free tools aur free plans use karte hain. Kuch tools ki daily limit hoti hai — uske tareeke course mein bataye gaye hain.

items.q: Mujhe editing nahi aati. Kya main kar paunga?
items.a: Haan. Course zero se shuru hota hai aur har step screen recording ke saath hai.
Course Hinglish mein hai — jaise hum roz baat karte hain. Tools ke English words waise hi rakhe gaye hain.
Har lesson chhota hai. Aap apni speed se dekh sakte hain — lifetime access hai, jab chahe dobara dekho.
Haan. Payment Razorpay ke through hota hai — UPI, card ya netbanking. Hum aapke card ya UPI ki details store nahi karte.
{days} din ke andar WhatsApp ya email par message karein. Refund 5–7 working days mein aapke original payment method par aata hai. Refund ke baad course access band ho jaata hai.
Lifetime. Ek account ek time par 2 devices par login reh sakta hai (jaise phone + laptop).
Nahi. Koi bhi honest course income ki guarantee nahi de sakta. Hum skill aur system sikhate hain — kamaai aapki mehnat, consistency aur content par depend karti hai.
